Privacy Policy

This policy explains how DMRK Insights collects, uses, stores, and shares information through the website, forms, newsletter flows, and demo admin tools.

Last updated: May 3, 2026

1. Scope of This Policy

This Privacy Policy applies to information collected through the DMRK Insights website and related online forms. It covers visitors, prospective clients, newsletter subscribers, partners, and other users who interact with our public pages. Separate client agreements may govern information shared during paid research, survey, consulting, or expert access engagements.

2. Information You Provide

We may collect information you choose to submit, including your name, business email, phone number, company, job title, country, industry, project needs, message content, newsletter preferences, and any details included in a consultation request. If you use a demo admin feature in the static site, content saved in that feature may be stored locally in your browser.

3. Information Collected Automatically

When you visit the website, we may collect basic technical and usage information such as pages viewed, referring page, browser type, device type, operating system, approximate location, time spent, and interaction patterns. This information helps us understand which resources are useful, diagnose website issues, and improve navigation and content quality.

4. Cookies and Similar Technologies

We may use cookies, local storage, pixels, or similar technologies for basic functionality, analytics, saved preferences, performance measurement, and security. For example, the static admin prototype uses browser storage to keep demo content edits on the same device. You can adjust cookie settings in your browser, although disabling cookies or local storage may affect certain features.

5. How We Use Information

We use collected information to respond to inquiries, scope research requests, prepare proposals, send newsletters or requested resources, manage contact records, improve site content, protect against misuse, analyze audience interests, and maintain business records. We may also use inquiry details to understand which industries, regions, and service lines are most relevant to prospective clients.

6. Research and Project Context

If you submit business questions, market context, competitor names, customer segments, or project requirements, we use that information to evaluate how DMRK Insights may help. Please avoid submitting confidential client data, sensitive personal data, regulated data, or trade secrets through public forms unless you are authorized and the information is necessary for the inquiry.

7. Newsletter and Marketing Communications

If you sign up for newsletters or request resources, we may use your contact details to send relevant updates, articles, reports, invitations, or service information. You can ask us to stop marketing communications at any time. We may still send non-marketing messages related to an inquiry, proposal, service request, or legal obligation.

8. Sharing With Service Providers

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with service providers who support hosting, analytics, email delivery, contact forms, customer relationship management, document preparation, security, or professional services. These providers are expected to use information only for the services they provide to us.

9. Legal, Safety, and Business Reasons

We may disclose information if required by law, regulation, legal process, government request, security investigation, rights protection, fraud prevention, or business transfer. If DMRK Insights is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or asset transfer, relevant information may be transferred as part of that transaction subject to appropriate safeguards.

10. Data Retention

We keep information for as long as needed to respond to requests, manage relationships, provide services, maintain records, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and improve our website. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information, the nature of the inquiry, and whether a formal client relationship is established.

11. Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. No website, email system, or online transmission is completely secure. You should use care when deciding what information to submit through online forms.

12. International Processing

Visitors may access this website from different countries, and service providers may process information in multiple locations. By using the website, you understand that information may be processed outside your state, province, or country, where privacy laws may differ.

13. Your Choices and Requests

You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your personal information where applicable. You may also ask to unsubscribe from marketing communications or update your contact preferences. We may need to verify your request and may retain certain information where required for legal, security, or legitimate business purposes.

14. Children's Privacy

The website is intended for business and professional audiences. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information, please contact us so we can review and delete it where appropriate.

15. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as our website, services, tools, or legal requirements change. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised date. Continued use of the website after an update means the revised policy applies going forward.

16. Contact

For privacy questions or requests, contact hello@dmrkinsights.com.
